reference_sql:
WITH week_purchases AS (
  -- one row per purchase event of 1 to 7 December 2025 (Dublin days): only the columns the totals need
  SELECT event_date, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'value')[1].value AS v
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'purchase'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251207'
)
SELECT event_date AS day, COUNT(*) AS purchases,
  SUM(COALESCE(v.int_value, v.float_value, v.double_value)) AS revenue
FROM week_purchases
GROUP BY event_date
